integrity: The proof verifies every finite-prefix admissibility inequality analytically and invokes the source's published continued-fraction tail criterion for the infinite tail. A bundled finite computation is used only as a stress test, not as evidence for the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves unboundedness through one explicit countable quadratic family; it does not determine the density or full structure of the admissible set.
The geometric rigidity conclusion remains restricted to the four-dimensional symmetric body-of-revolution setting of the cited source.
title: An explicit unbounded quadratic family of admissible non-central section areas
